verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has a well-documented public REST API with official SDKs (Node.js OAuth client, PHP SDK with CRUD examples) and even a dedicated MCP server exposing 145 tools covering the full API, enabling AI-native/agentic access. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (probes show 404s) and independent hands-on developer corroboration beyond official repos.
